skill.name: code-review
skill.description: Perform code reviews following Sentry engineering practices. Use when reviewing pull requests, examining code changes, or providing feedback on code quality. Covers security, performance, testing, and design review.
skill.summary: Guide AI-assisted pull request reviews using Sentry engineering practices.
skill.author: davila7

static_findings.snippet: Verify tests cover actual requirements and edge cases. Avoid excessive branching or looping in test
- **Runtime errors**: Potential exceptions, null pointer issues, out-of-bounds access

content.value_statement: Pull requests need focused review across correctness, security, tests, and maintainability. This skill gives Claude, Codex, or Claude Code a structured checklist based on Sentry engineering practices.
actual_capabilities: Guides pull request review for runtime errors, performance risks, and side effects.
Checks whether tests cover requirements, edge cases, and critical user paths.
Flags changes that need senior review, such as schema updates and API contracts.
Encourages actionable, polite feedback with clear approval guidance.
Provides example review concerns for Django queries, React effects, and SQL injection.
limitations: It does not run tests, linters, or security scanners automatically.
It depends on the code diff and project context provided by the user.
Its guidance is tuned to Sentry engineering practices.
It cannot replace human ownership of final approval decisions.

use_cases.title: Review a Pull Request
use_cases.description: Apply a structured checklist before approving a change.

use_cases.title: Improve Review Consistency
use_cases.description: Standardize feedback across correctness, tests, performance, and security.

use_cases.title: Prepare Safer Changes
use_cases.description: Self-review a branch before requesting feedback from teammates.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Pull Request Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pull request using the code-review skill. Focus on correctness, test coverage, and clear action items.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small change

prompt_templates.title: Risk-Focused Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this diff for security vulnerabilities, runtime errors, and backwards compatibility risks. Separate blocking issues from suggestions.

prompt_templates.title: Framework Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this Django or React change using Sentry practices. Call out performance, query behavior, side effects, and missing tests.

prompt_templates.title: Senior Review Pass
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this multi-file change as a senior engineer. Assess architecture, API contracts, migration risk, and whether escalation is needed.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a broad change

output_examples.input: A pull request adds a Django query inside a loop.
output: Blocking: This may create an N+1 query on large user lists.
Suggestion: Prefetch related profile data and add a regression test.

output_examples.input: A React effect loads data but omits a changing identifier from dependencies.
output: Issue: The effect can use stale input when the identifier changes.
Suggestion: Include the dependency or explain why it is intentionally stable.

output_examples.input: A change modifies an API response used by existing clients.
output: Blocking: This may break backwards compatibility without a migration path.
Suggestion: Document the contract change and add coverage for old and new clients.

best_practices: Provide the diff, test results, and product context with each review request.
Ask for blocking findings first, then request non-blocking suggestions.
Include framework details when reviewing Django, React, or API changes.
anti_patterns: Asking for approval without sharing the relevant code diff.
Treating stylistic preferences as blocking review issues.
Using the review output as a substitute for required tests.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews code changes for correctness, tests, performance, security, design fit, and long-term maintainability.

faq.question: Does it run code or tests?
faq.answer: No. It provides review guidance based on the code and context supplied by the user.

faq.question: Is it only for Sentry projects?
faq.answer: No. The guidance is based on Sentry practices, but many checks apply to general software projects.

faq.question: Can it review security issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It prompts the assistant to check for injection, XSS, access control gaps, and secrets exposure.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the pull request diff, related tests, expected behavior, and any project-specific review standards.

faq.question: Can it approve pull requests?
faq.answer: It can recommend approval when only minor issues remain, but humans keep final ownership of approval.
